'''Rint''' was a female [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as an armsmaster in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]], she set up shop in [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]] in the [[Incorporation Islands]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Armsmaster Rint appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as an Modification Commendations Vendor for Imperial players on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" />
